title: The welcome flow dropped off
instructions: Something's up with the welcome series — revenue from it fell off a cliff in June and no one changed anything. Can you figure out what happened and what it's costing us? Need it for Thursday's standup.

criteria.text: Identifies the expired SOLSTICE10 code as the root cause of the welcome-flow revenue drop.
States the drop began with the June cohort, consistent with the May 31 code expiry.
Revenue-impact estimate reconciles with pre/post conversion delta × entry volume × AOV, within tolerance.

extract.hint: the claimed monthly revenue impact of the welcome-flow drop, in dollars

criteria.text: Does not attribute the drop to seasonality, deliverability, or the (irrelevant) March Yahoo incident.
Proposes both an immediate fix and a prevention practice (e.g. code-expiry monitoring).
Notes the affected cohort could be re-mailed a working code.
